items.claim: Turned pool moves when a lane is resized
Lane resize moves locked nodes in later lanes
Releasing a lane moves locked members of later lanes
Pool shrunk below its lanes leaves them hanging out
`addLane` throws on a negative or fractional index
items.note: This was my call: it now throws a `RangeError`, and an index past the end still adds at the end. It is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: `addLane` with an explicit style skips the restripe of later lanes
Hidden lanes still offer a resize boundary
Drop-parent search misses a container overhanging its parent's body
`addLane` places the lane in the pool's local frame whatever the composition
items.note: This also covers a turned pool.

items.claim: Lane-resize commit leaves later lanes' members behind under a non-rigid composition
items.note: Under `IDENTITY_POSE_COMPOSITION` a container carries nothing ("moving it moves nothing else"). The preview doesn't carry them either: `carriedDescendants` leaves them out, and a test showed their preview pose is null. So the preview and the commit already agree.

items.claim: `laneResizeFrame` previews titles in the local frame regardless of composition
items.note: This is the same rewrite as the turned-pool fix, because the commit now writes exactly the poses the preview shows. Each fix has its own changeset.

items.claim: Pool shrunk below its lanes, lanes spill out
items.note: duplicate of the A finding above (9988e29d4c)

items.claim: A point on the header/body edge counts as both header and body
Pool narrower than its header gets negative-width lanes
items.note: The scene already corrected them once the layout ran, but the ops `containerBuild` returns carried the negative widths. `firstLanes` and `addLane` now both build lanes inside the body.

items.claim: Header double-click tests a world point against the stored, parent-local box
Releasing a lane draws its members under the pool's fill
`diagramCanDropInto`'s plain-group branch admits marks, sequence parts and anchor/mark traits
`diagramDropParentAt` puts stencils into locked or hidden containers and never asks `canDropInto`
items.note: Each candidate now goes through core's `childVerdict`. When no `canDropInto` is given it defaults to `diagramCanDropInto`, because diagram containers are marks and core's own default refuses marks. The host's `canReparent` is still not asked about an insert: with no ids, the verdict is true before `canReparent` comes up. Core's insert path behaves the same way.

items.claim: Adding a lane at an index colors it by child order, not stack order
items.note: `themeWrites` now ranks lanes by their midpoint, as `laneStackLayout` does. `addLane` also recolors the lanes after the new one, since they move down a place.

items.claim: Lane affordances and the resize drag ignore a pool's rotation
`containerBuild` hard-codes the rigid composition while `addLane` uses the scene's
items.note: For pools, the layout pass rewrites lane poses and hid the bug. It showed in `stencilInsertOps`, which had the same hard-coding and is fixed in the same commit. Both now take a `composition` option, and `useStencilInsert` passes the scene's.

items.claim: Growing a lane past the lanes after it reorders them on commit
`diagramDropParentAt` composes poses through envelopes, which define no frame
items.note: The walk also stopped at any node whose own box missed the point. That pruned envelopes and plain groups, whose boxes need not cover their children, so it now prunes only at regions.

items.claim: A lane can move into a pool stacking along the other axis
items.note: I made the strict call to refuse it rather than rewrite the lane's header and layout, and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: Region header and body hit-tests ignore rotation in `regionHeaderAt` and `diagramDropParentAt`
